text: On the authority of Anas - may God be pleased with him - he said: We were afflicted with rain with the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace. He said: Then the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, shed his garment until it was soaked by the rain, so we said: O Messenger of God! Why did you make this? He said: Because it is a hadith of a covenant with his Lord
